items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: He was with Sam Wooding's orchestra, we really had a ball.

ctx.x: Yes, yes, he was a nice boy. I really got along nicely when I first met him in Vienna. We got along nicely.
I forgot to say something about when I met Sam Wooding's band in Vienna. I was surprised. One of the trumpet players was -- did I mention that?
